intent: A dark list of saved cards drawn as generic objects, with no network logos. The accent outline travels to whichever card is default, and removing a card leaves an inline undo rather than a toast.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @md for the two-column grid; colour tokens as CSS variables (--pay-surface, --pay-raised, --pay-track, --pay-ink, --pay-muted, --pay-accent, --pay-accent-text)
stack.animation: motion/react for the entrance, the travelling default outline and the undo row
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) for the heading; font-sans for actions; font-mono for the cards, the eyebrow and the masked number

layout.header: mono BILLING, 22px heading Cards, a line naming the default card
layout.grid: one column below 448px, two columns from there
layout.card: dark object, aspect 1.7, workspace, chip, masked last 4, holder, expiry; Default or Set default, and Remove, under the object
layout.undo: a hairline row under the grid: the masked number, removed, and Undo
layout.add: a full-width Add a card button that is replaced by the form: name, last 4, expiry, Cancel

typography.label: mono 11px, weight 500, uppercase, tracking 0.08em, muted
typography.heading: font-display 22px, weight 600, tracking -0.025em, leading 1.1
typography.card: number mono 13px, 14px in the two-column layout, tracking 0.14em; holder and expiry mono 10.5px

color.approach: greys with one accent prop (default #7dd3a8) for the default outline, the Default label and a valid Add button; cards stay dark in both themes; the chip #d9c7a3 is material, not a second accent; no red
color.accentText: on light, color-mix(in oklch, accent 45%, ink)

motion.entrance: header, cards at 100ms, add button at 200ms; rise 10px out of an 8px blur over 500ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), then filter cleared
motion.default: the outline springs from the old default to the new one, stiffness 420, damping 36
motion.remove: the card fades; the undo row rises 6px over 240ms
motion.press: scale 0.985 on Add a card, 0.98 on the form submit
motion.reducedMotion: opacity only; the outline jumps; no scale

responsive.390: the two cards stack; the number stays one line; Set default and Remove stay on one row
responsive.1440: the two cards sit side by side inside the 560px panel

accessibility: Set default, Remove, Undo, Cancel and Add are buttons
the subtitle and the undo row are polite live regions
form fields are labelled; a refused draft is an alert
2px ink focus outlines with a 2px offset, keyboard only

content.demo: make 1881 the default, then remove 4242, and leave the undo row on screen

avoid: Visa, Mastercard or any network logo
disabling Add instead of explaining the draft
